item.title: Consistency pays well
item.description:
This is the lead area.

What if you could make money just by writing consistently about a topic you love? Of the list of things that I have started over the years and dropped midway, writing falls pretty high up there. And why? Turns out consistency isn’t as easy as the word makes it sound.
